tokens.name: space.ramp.base
tokens.role: Use compact repeatable increments as the base of the global spacing ramp.
tokens.notes: Use the documented ramp, not arbitrary multiples everywhere.

tokens.name: color.palette.roles
tokens.role: Separate neutral foundation, shared semantic colors, and brand color roles.
tokens.notes: Brand color should not replace semantic roles.

tokens.name: type.sentence.case
tokens.role: Use readable sentence-case hierarchy for interface language rather than decorative capitalization.
tokens.notes: Especially relevant to product controls and headings.
